name: Zero-shot RNA language model benchmark (Wang et al. 2026)
description: Standardised zero-shot evaluation of 21 RNA language models, with DNA language models as reference controls, on attention-based secondary structure prediction, embedding-based RNA classification and likelihood-based mutational fitness prediction.

attributes.task: Zero-shot RNA secondary structure, RNA classification and ncRNA fitness prediction
attributes.scope_note: No fine-tuning. Secondary structure on TS (70 PDB structures) and TS-Hard (15) with a head-layer and threshold chosen on VL1 (40); classification of homologous versus non-homologous sequence pairs on RfamSample (561 Rfam families) and ArchiveII-Nr (1273 RNAs) from FFT or CLS embeddings; fitness on 31 RNAGym ncRNA deep mutational scanning assays (wild-type length <= 440 nt) with WT-LLR or PLL-D scores.
attributes.source_locator: Main text Methods 'RNA secondary structure', 'RNA classification', 'RNA DMS assays'; Supplementary Tables 4-11
limitations: RNA-MSM is from the corresponding authors' group (Zhang et al.); the TS and VL1 sets come from the same group's earlier work (ref. 29).
Models are included per task only where their attention, embeddings or logits were available (Supplementary Table 3).
